newsitem.title: ZIMBABWE: ZIMBABWE DOLLAR ENDS THURSDAY WEAKER ON UNITS.
newsitem.headline: ZIMBABWE DOLLAR ENDS THURSDAY WEAKER ON UNITS.

text.p: The Zimbabwe dollar was quoted softer on key currencies after a fairly brisk Thursday interbank trading session, foreign exchange dealers said.

"The market went up and down like a yo-yo today. We saw some early morning buying which pushed the price up to 11.4050/4150 (on the U.S. dollar) then there was panic selling towards the end," one dealer commented.

He said the local currency finally settled to close at 11.3900/4000 on the U.S. dollar, weaker compared to Wednesday's 11.3850/3950 and was quoted at 19.2260/2550 versus pound sterling from 19.2115/2880.
It was at 6.5100/5140 from 6.4650/4920 against the mark and at 2.5030/5040 against South Africa's rand compared to the previous day's 2.5005/5105.
